atoms.text: Hi, my name is Nando. Winter holidays are my favourite holidays because I love the cold weather. The best days of the year are those when the ground is covered with snow. On those days, I would take my sled, run to the big hill in the park and go sledging until my dad would call me to come home for dinner.

atoms.text: Hey, my name is Maya. I also love it when it snows in winter, but I don’t like to go sledging. I would rather stay inside and listen to music or snuggle on the couch with my family and watch a film. For me, winter is just a very calm and peaceful time.
